lines.text: Nehemiah was already building when the invitations started — four times, same offer, dressed up as reasonable.
Come down, let's talk, let's meet halfway. It never once looked like an attack.
I am doing a great work,
so that I cannot come down.
Maybe you've gotten the same invitation today — a call, a scroll, a reasonable-sounding reason to leave the wall unfinished.
Give it the same answer, every single time it comes back dressed differently.
Keep building. The wall still needs you. In Jesus' name, amen.

title: Word and Faith Network
subtitle: I Cannot Come Down
story: A three-scene illustrated short film on Nehemiah 6:2-4: a lone figure working a torchlit stone wall at night while amber light glows beyond it, a sealed scroll resting on a flat hazy plain with a small distant figure beckoning from far off, and dawn breaking gold over the same figure standing firm atop the finished wall with arms raised.
